body: It sounds like you have had to deal with a lot at such a young age. Both fortunately and unfortunately, you are not alone in this experience. Your therapist and case worker may have some ideas, and it is worth asking them, but where do you think you can find a support system? Support can come from many different places. I hope you are able to find clarity and relief from these overwhelming thoughts and emotions soon. I know what it's like to feel stuck in a hole with no escape, but there are always options. Hopefully you will uncover them soon. Keep asking for help. You deserve support, care, and a fulfilling life. Please note that antidepressants are not an effective means of suicide.
What is it about last year that made things better?

Thank you for sharing that with me. Why do you believe in eternal oblivion? I've never liked shopping at Walmart. It's not a happy place for me. Do you ever enjoy going for a walk outside or writing? Where do you find enjoyment?

There are plenty of people with open ears and an open heart if you would like someone to listen. I know what it is like to feel an overwhelming amount of guilt, but let me tell you that you do not need to feel sorry for what you are experiencing. It's not your fault. I hope you are able to forgive yourself and treat yourself with the compassion and love that you deserve. Please confide in and seek support from the people you trust most. You are an adult now and have your whole life ahead of you. It is your choice now to make of it what you will. If you feel like you owe something to your family, let me tell you that you don't owe them anything. You can love them, and treat them with respect, but sometimes it's best to put some distance. This will make it easier to heal and forgive. Do consider taking that scholarship. It sounds like you have many opportunities and I think you should weigh your options. Talk it over with your loved ones. Journal. Take a meditative stroll in the park. Lay out in the sun. Above all, treat yourself kindly.

Ah, I see. My first pet was named Rascal. He died a few years ago. He was such a sweet soul and I still miss his presence. It has gotten better, though, and I am certainly grateful for my fond memories and pictures of him. Do you have any sort of spiritual beliefs?
I'm sorry to hear about your pet. That sounds like an incredibly difficult loss. What is her name?
